ITEM 1 | Pale yellow-tan cubed/wedge pieces with browned, slightly caramelized edges and patchy golden-brown spots on the skin, matte surface with a slight sheen, firm and holding shape, roughly 2-3 cm pieces with cut faces showing a lighter interior, resting in a white foam bowl about 15 cm across covering roughly 30% of its surface | 110

ITEM 2 | Small faint orange-red specks and smears on the white bowl surface, possibly a thin residue of sauce or seasoning, flat and dry-looking with no pooling, covering under 5% of the bowl | 3

ITEM 3 | Thin dark brown cooked-on residue along the rim and bottom of the bowl, matte and not flowing, nearly invisible | 2
